show.title: Soulection Radio Show #153 w/ Dream Koala
show.content:
Joe Kay kicked things off with heavy, heavy vibes from many brand new/unheard artists and collectives. 
<!--more-->

The selection in here was really well thought out and analyzed properly so take notes.

Shouts to Geode and the Chord Marauders who sent over their forthcoming compilation which is simply amazing. Pay attention to these guys, trust. Also look out for Sunni Colòn & Jarreau Vandal. These two artists will be breakthrough artists on Soulection in 2014; guaranteed. We had special guest Dream Koala stop by who is visiting LA for his 1st time all the way from Berlin (current residence but originally from Paris). The young 19 year old threw down a DJ set that included bass and uptempo tribal vibes. In fact, his set was very different from his original production. Dream Koala is very talented and we look forward to see and hear what's to come. 

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #154
show.content:
Joe Kay really displayed a crazy selection of music that will have you copying/pasting consistently within Google for some time.

There are a lot of new tunes sprinkled with the 'feel-good' classics that we always connect to our sets. It's essential for us to keep educating you with the influences and how it all connects to where we are today. Spread this set to as many people as possible! More minds and ears need to hear this music!

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #156 w/ J-Louis
show.content:
Joe Kay is joined by Soulection's very own iPhone producer J-Louis.

<!--more-->
As some of you may or may not know, J-Louis produces all his music on the iPhone [(Nano Studio App)](https://apps.apple.com/gb/developer/blip-interactive-ltd/id382263654?at=1010lMz4). He even put out a free EP with us in the beginning of the year entitled ["Balanced"](https://soulection.bandcamp.com/album/balanced-ep) which was also produced entirely on the iPhone. This 20 year-old from Azusa, CA is really a special guy who we feel is going to be BIG in the near future as long as he stays on track with his progression.

J-Louis played an exclusive set for a little over 30 minutes with all his recent unreleased productions and then chopped it up with us about his musical background (Drummer since he was 8 years-old & played in a Hardcore band & toured when he was 12) and how he purchased a stolen Macbook Pro (without knowing) to start producing on a computer that was eventually stolen -- forcing him to produce on his iPhone again. 

What a journey! Joe Kay also made sure to talk about his experience at the Yeezus tour this past Friday and later went into a heavy discussion about rumors of Soulection being part of Free-masonry/Illuminati. Very interesting and informative conversations going on as always.


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #164 w/ Jamil & Tunji
show.content:
3 Hours of 'just music' with friends Jamil & Tunji.
<!--more-->

This Soulection Radio session is one for the books! We wanted to switch it up on you, put the full 3 hours of 'just music' aside and inform you with some real knowledge from some great friends of ours who are some very important people that you need to know. Jamil who is Drake's touring manager and G-Eazy's co-manager is someone who has reached out to us and showed us so much support. Tunji on the other hand is an army swiss knife! He is an A&R at Interscope and is one of the most humble and diverse A&R's in the game. One of the few that truly understands the sound of tomorrow and is responsible for some amazing connections going on in the industry. Really listen to what they have to say and take notes!

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #165 w/ Lakim, Andres, Sunni Colòn, & J-Louis
show.content:
Soulection 3 Year pre-party Celebration!
<!--more-->

We had a packed house at Kbeach with plenty of good vibes flowing. In fact it was Joe's first time meeting Lakim in person after all these years. This is Lakim's first time out in L.A. so we wanted to make sure Lakim was welcomed properly. We had him drop a quick preview set on the radio show and talk about his forthcoming album "This Is Her" a little. We also had Andres drop a quick set to switch up the vibes, After Andres, we had Sunni Colòn & J-Louis both come on and preview some remixes that we've been putting together. So much talent in one room. Big ups to Marvel Alexander and shouts to everyone who came out to our 3 year Anniversary party. It was massive and hectic at the same time. Stay tuned for our announcement to our new Soulection monthly.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
